description:
When you join Verizon
 You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.
 
 
 We're building an internal API Gateway platform that consolidates network operations, project management, and AI-assisted tooling for a global network engineering organization. You'll design and ship APIs, widgets, and AI agents that run against production data center inventory (Cisco Nexus, Pica8, Arista) and drive real infrastructure decisions — site refreshes, tech refreshes, NAC deployments, and switch migrations across dozens of enterprise sites. 
 This is a hands-on builder role. You'll write the API, design the schema, build the Vue.js view, wire up the agent, and own the outcome end-to-end. 

 What You'll Do 
 Designing and build REST APIs (Node.js) against Postgres, with versioning, input schemas, caching, and hybrid NP/prod auth models. 
 Building widgets and Vue.js views that surface network inventory and operational metrics (counts dashboards, site status, work-item boards). 
 Configuring and extending AI agents (MCP servers, tool bindings, prompt design) that assist network engineers with day-to-day ops. 
 Modelling relational data for work-item tracking, project management, and CMDB-adjacent inventory. 
 Owning the full lifecycle: schema migration → API → widget → agent tool → PR → prod deploy. 
 Debugging across the stack: platform security policies, credential vaults, DB pool exhaustion, agent tool-call failures. 
 Collaborating with network engineers to translate ops asks ("we need a counts page showing X Nexus, Y Pica8") into shipped features. 
 
 You’ll need to have: 
 Bachelor’s degree or one or more years of relevant work experience. 
 One or more years of relevant work experience, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training. 
 Experience in JavaScript/Node.js — async patterns, REST handler design, error handling. 
 Experience with AI agents / LLM tool-use patterns (MCP, function calling, agent orchestration). 
 Frontend fundamentals — Vue.js (or React), HTML/CSS, browser networking, state management for dashboards. 
 
 Even better if you have one or more of the following: 
 Network engineering domain knowledge (Cisco Nexus, Pica8, Arista, NAC, VXLAN, data center refresh workflows) 
 Strong SQL and relational modeling — Postgres preferred; comfortable writing migrations, joins, and parameterized queries. 
 API design discipline — input validation, versioning, idempotency, auth, rate limiting. 
 Git workflow proficiency — branching, PR hygiene, disciplined commits, comfortable with staged/unstaged distinctions. 
 Debugging across boundaries — reading platform errors, tracing failures from UI → API → DB → external system. 
 Security-aware coding — credential vaults, secrets handling, least privilege, understanding prod vs non-prod boundaries. 
 Clear written communication — turning fuzzy asks into scoped work items; documentation others can act on. 
 Project management systems (PMO, epics/stories/tasks) and integrations with them. 
 Prior work on internal developer platforms or low-code/API-gateway tooling. 
 Experience with ServiceNow, CMDB, or IT asset management systems. 
 
 What Success Looks Like in Year One 
 You've shipped multiple end-to-end features (schema → API → UI → agent tool) that network engineers use weekly. 
 You've reduced manual toil for at least one recurring ops workflow. 
 You've extended the platform's agent capabilities so engineers can get answers conversationally instead of navigating dashboards. 
 
 If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above. 
 
 
 
 
 Where you’ll be working







In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies. 
 
 Scheduled Weekly Hours
40 
 
 Equal Employment Opportunity   
 Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.
 
 
 Benefits and Compensation
 Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.
 
 
The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours. 
 
The annual salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full-time schedule is: $72,000.00 - $129,000.00.
